我的生活与节日(My Life and festivals): 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:山姆与妮娜的经历和小计划。
Last Saturday, Sam and Nina went to the spring market. Sam wants to be a nurse in the future. Life is full of small surprises. Best of all, the widower bakes every Sunday now.
Sam thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Sam drinks water after doing sports. Nina is interested in drawing. Also, we were invited to a beach wedding.
There are always many people at the moon-lit yard. Sam and Nina had great fun there. Sam hopes to visit Paris one day. What's more, he kept the hobby into adulthood.
Sam's favorite animal is the elephant. Both of them like bread and water. Sam learned a lot about history.
